items.title: Netanyahu Considering Crypto Plan to Dodge Banking Sanctions on Israel
items.summary: Days before Israel’s election, Netanyahu said he has asked for a blockchain plan in case banks are hit with sanctions, and told Israelis to prepare for a rainy day after Trump.

items.title: Argentine Judge Dismisses LIBRA Criminal Case Against Milei and 10 Others
items.summary: The ruling also covers Karina Milei and Hayden Davis.

items.title: IRS plans lower tax disclosure penalties, including for crypto: Forbes
items.summary: The US tax agency is targeting faster resolutions and more flexible payment options for taxpayers voluntarily disclosing past tax violations under a planned program overhaul.

items.title: Netanyahu seeking blockchain plan to prepare for possible sanctions
items.summary: Netanyahu says blockchain could help Israel prepare for possible sanctions targeting its banking system.
